title: Specification of circuit compilation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, $c$ a Boolean circuit tree on $n$ variables, and $gs$ a finite list of gates such that every input to its $i$th gate has index less than $n+i$. Compiling $c$ after $gs$ produces an extended gate list and a root vertex. The resulting list extends $gs$, is acyclic in the same sense, and the root index is less than $n$ plus the length of the resulting list. For every assignment of Boolean values to the variables, the value at the root equals the value of $c$. The resulting list has length at most $|gs|$ plus the size of $c$, and the depth at the root is at most the depth of $c$ plus $1$. Each newly appended gate has distinct input indices, any NOT gate among them has exactly one input, and each has at most $\max(1,F)$ inputs, where $F$ is the maximum fanin of $c$.
